levels.name: Foundations
levels.why: First level of contract 1: A, Z, D(2), one fire room, Warrior(5), no rule.

levels.name: Contractual Obligation
levels.why: A/Z/D only, one Warrior, no spells, one dist rule (milestone 1).

levels.name: Around The Bush
levels.why: A, Z, 2×D(1), one fire room, Warrior(5), rule dist(A, Z) = 2 (same distance form as 1.2).

levels.name: Low Blow
levels.why: Smallest spell level: A, Z, D(2), Warrior(4), one Attack(3), no rule.

levels.name: Fire Immunity
levels.why: A, Z, fire room; Elf(1, {fire}) then Warrior(1); one Attack(1). Attack also hits heroes still in the waiting room.

levels.name: Elemental Sanctuary
levels.why: Smallest Elf level: A, Z, fire, water, ice rooms; Elf(3,{water}) and Elf(3,{ice}); rule dist(A, Z) != 2.

levels.name: Cross With the Constraint - Watered Down
levels.why: Warrior(4) with A, Z, 2×D(1), fire and water: water blocks the short way; rule ∃s ∈ Π, dist(s,A) = dist(s,Z) = 1.

levels.name: Cross With the Constraint
levels.why: Same as 2.4 with ice instead of water: the Warrior slides across the ice room.

levels.name: Teleportation Station
levels.why: Smallest portal level: A, Z, poison, P(1, 1); Warrior(6), no spells, no rule.

levels.name: Fake Reset
levels.why: A, Z, D(11), poison; Warrior(20); 2×Teleport(2); rule: no hero below 0 HP. The only real poison level without portals or other spells.

levels.name: Wealth Frontier
levels.why: Smallest gold + toll level: A, Z, D(1), O(1), T(1, fire); Warrior(5), no rule.

levels.name: Vault Break
levels.why: Elf gold + toll level: A, Z, D(1), O(1), T(1, fire), T(1, water); Elf(1, {fire}) then Elf(13, {water}).
